headline: 影劇圈今日三則短評
context: 先看老片重映：法國導演夏布洛（Claude Chabrol）1969年的心理驚悚片《La Femme Infidèle》，趁著倫敦BFI南岸的夏布洛影展重新上映。再看新片：《Practical Magic》推出續集，Owens家族與她們的詛咒再度回到大銀幕。最後是舞台劇：倫敦漢普斯特劇院的音樂劇《Kimberly Akimbo》，講一個罕見早衰症少女的故事，這次由瑪莉亞·佛里曼主演。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Claude Chabrol’s 1969 film charts a complex marriage in which a husband suspects his wife is cheating on him Writer-director Claude Chabrol’s eerie 1969 masterpiece of frozen emotions and unspoken truths is now rereleased, alongside a Chabrol season at London’s BFI Southbank. This is the suspense thriller remade by Adrian Lyne in 2002 as Unfaithful with Richard Gere and Diane Lane and (partly) remade again this year as Minotaur , a bitter and brilliant theme-variation by the Russian director Andrey Zvyagintsev. As for the original, watched again now, it does not in fact look like a classic noir thriller in the style of Chabrol’s hero Hitchcock, which is how it is often described, but more like something by Buñuel: an elaborate absurdist joke at the expense of the French bourgeoisie, a ballet of repression and fear. The unfaithful woman of the title is the glacially beautiful but glassy-eyed Hélène, played by Chabrol’s then wife Stéphane Audran. She is cheating on Charles, played by Michel Bouquet, her prosperous husband and the father of their adored 10-year-old son. Charles has begun to suspect something is going on during his wife’s frequent trips to Paris, where she supposedly has appointments with the beautician, goes shopping or visits the cinema, but in fact has sex with the divorced writer Victor Pegala (Maurice Ronet) at his dishevelled bachelor flat. Charles phones the beauty parlour where she is supposed to be getting a treatment; she isn’t there. We see how this only confirms suspicions which have clearly accumulated in his mind like silt over months or even years. Continue reading...
sources.title: La Femme Infidèle review – Chabrol’s eerie domestic thriller is a brilliant ballet of repression and fear

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Hampstead theatre, London Maria Friedman plays a 15-year-old with a rare ageing condition in a heartfelt and funny show that manages to sustain its sweetness It’s a bizarre concept for a musical: a girl with a rare condition that causes her to age four times faster than her peers, in a family so dysfunctional that she’s the normal one. Meanwhile, the musical highlights are songs about cheque fraud and scurvy. And yet, somehow, through all this artifice and elaborate setup comes a show so sincerely heartfelt, one that is genuine, hilarious and utterly endearing. Kimberly Akimbo started out as a play, in 2001, by Pulitzer prize-winner David Lindsay-Abaire, adapted into a musical with composer Jeanine Tesori (Shrek, Fun Home, Caroline, or Change) in 2021. It was lauded on Broadway, where audiences fell for its feels and kooky charm and it won five Tony awards . Continue reading...
sources.title: Kimberly Akimbo review – hilarious musical about a sexagenarian teen is one for the ages

thread_text:
影劇圈今日三則短評

先看老片重映。法國導演夏布洛（Claude Chabrol）1969年的心理驚悚片《La Femme Infidèle》，趁著倫敦BFI南岸的夏布洛影展重新上映。這部片後來被翻拍成2002年李察·吉爾主演的《出軌》，也啟發了今年薩金塞夫的新作《Minotaur》。

再看新片。《Practical Magic》推出續集，Owens家族與她們的詛咒再度回到大銀幕。

最後是舞台劇。倫敦漢普斯特劇院的音樂劇《Kimberly Akimbo》，講一個罕見早衰症少女的故事，曾拿下五座東尼獎，這次由瑪莉亞·佛里曼（Maria Friedman）主演。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian、The New York Times，2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
影劇圈今日三則短評

先看老片重映。法國導演夏布洛（Claude Chabrol）1969年的心理驚悚片《La Femme Infidèle》，趁著倫敦BFI南岸的夏布洛影展重新上映。片中描寫一段婚姻裡，丈夫逐漸起疑，懷疑妻子外遇。這部片後來被翻拍成2002年李察·吉爾、黛安·蓮恩主演的《出軌》，也啟發了今年俄羅斯導演薩金塞夫的新作《Minotaur》。有評論認為，這部片與其說像希區考克式的驚悚片，其實更接近布紐爾式對中產階級的荒謬諷刺。

再看新片。奇幻系列電影《Practical Magic》推出續集，Owens家族與她們的詛咒再度回到大銀幕。

最後是舞台劇。倫敦漢普斯特劇院的音樂劇《Kimberly Akimbo》，講一個罹患罕見早衰症、外表已是六旬老婦的15歲少女的故事，這齣戲2021年在百老匯首演後拿下五座東尼獎，這次英國演出由瑪莉亞·佛里曼（Maria Friedman）主演，評論形容它既好笑又動人。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 先看一部老片重映。法國導演夏布洛1969年的心理驚悚片，趁著倫敦一場影展重新上映，講一段婚姻裡，丈夫漸漸起疑，懷疑妻子外遇。這部片後來被翻拍成2002年的《出軌》，也啟發了今年一部新作。換個話題，看新片。奇幻系列電影《魔法奇緣》推出續集，那個帶著詛咒的家族又回到大銀幕。最後是舞台劇。倫敦有一齣音樂劇，講一個罹患罕見早衰症、外表已是六旬老婦的15歲少女，這齣戲拿過五座東尼獎，評論說它既好笑又動人。
